codes.description: The operator stopped the attempt before measurement completed.
Required source or artifact provenance is absent.
Observed provenance differs from the frozen run input.
An artifact digest is malformed or does not match its bytes.
An attempt contains more than one immutable series identity.
Observed environment identity differs from the frozen run input.
A worker heartbeat gap exceeded five seconds.
A traffic worker exited unexpectedly.
A bounded runner IPC queue reached its hard cap.
The active participant count differs from the profile.
Room count, membership, or room size differs from the profile.
A critical command has no terminal result after its grace period.
A server invariant counter is nonzero.
A required latency or queue sample count is below its minimum.
Private metrics samples do not cover the required interval.
An immutable fact stream is malformed, truncated, or out of order.
Wall or monotonic clock evidence is inconsistent.
A claim-bearing source tree was dirty.
The workload profile violates its versioned contract.
Traffic scheduler slip exceeded the profile validity bound.
Required command emission coverage is incomplete.
Server ranking evidence violates the result contract.
The final result participant set differs from the room.
A durable reward recipient differs from the server-owned winner.
Final result became visible before required durable append.
The room reopened before required durable append.
The same room did not enter the next battle cycle correctly.
A stale session, battle, or transport generation mutated state.
One server-owned drop was applied more than once.
One settlement identity was applied more than once.
The same settlement identity was observed with different content.
The fixed Loot Race did not cover every participant's attack, loot, and defeated-result path.
Active gameplay made no server-observed progress for more than five seconds.
Critical action terminal latency exceeded its gate.
Room mailbox queue delay exceeded its gate.
Active snapshot interval exceeded its gate.
Durable append latency exceeded its gate.
Game process CPU busy exceeded the profile limit.
Game process RSS exceeded the profile limit.
File descriptor usage exceeded the profile limit.
The oldest pending outbox record exceeded its age gate.
The outbox did not drain before the closeout deadline.
A required evidence artifact is absent.
An evidence artifact checksum differs from its manifest.
A public artifact crossed the sanitization boundary.
The evidence package manifest violates its contract.
